name: Simon Fraser University
header:
Simon Fraser University
Canada · Mathematics MSc / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 301-350. Additional research-fit program; outside Canada top ten including ties. Official QS
public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• All documents and three letters are dueJanuary11, 2027; pay/submit5-7days early to unlock reference
invitations.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
A completed UChicago bachelor’s permits MSc consideration, subject to minimum CGPA 3.0 or equivalent.
Mathematics specifies a completed master’s and CGPA 3.5 for PhD; exceptional transfer from an SFU MSc is
possible. Central regulations allow some bachelor’s-to-PhD admission at higher GPAs, but math’s narrower rule
controls unless the department confirms an exception. International applicants are eligible; F-1 is not Canadian
study authorization. [s1] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use goGRAD; prepare CV, a 1-2-page research statement, all postsecondary records and three referees.
Supervisor contact is optional. Submit the form and pay 5-7 days before the final deadline so the checklist and
reference invitations can be completed in time. No pre-application supervisor promise guarantees admission.
[s1] [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Optional before application: applicants need not secure a supervisor in advance and are matched by research
fit. Contact specific faculty about 2027 availability if desired; faculty cannot promise admission independently
of formal review. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
goGRAD sequence: form→payment→checklist/uploads/referee invitations. Submit/pay 5-7 days early. Status
page shows the program deadline and document checks; use recommendation-page Edit for referee
corrections before deadline. Decisions arrive via email linking to the portal; acceptance requires online reply
and deposit. [s2] [s3] [s8]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 dates explicitly confirmed centrally. Department heading mistakenly saysFall 2026 while giving
2026-27 application dates. Fee, TOEFL and tuition portions of math page lag central updates. Standing funding
policy applies to entrants fromFall 2024 onward but does not publish a 2027-28 tuition figure. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
[s6] [s7]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027: opens October 15, 2026; closes January 11, 2027. All materials must be complete then; no late
applications. No closing hour/time zone is stated. Central mathematics FAQ confirms Fall 2027, correcting the
department page’s inconsistent Fall 2026 label. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [Conflict]
Admission/regular funding/entrance nomination file: January 11, 2027. Math says all timely applicants receive
entrance-award consideration. Central donor-entrance process additionally describes invitations in March/April
and applicant information due April 30 (standing, year/time zone unspecified); confirm whether nominated
awards require this later step. [s1] [s2] [s10]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
All THREE reference submissions must be received by January 11, 2027, with the complete math application.
No separate grace period is advertised; time zone and closing hour are not public. [s1] [s2]
Test-score receipt [Conflict]

but note official verification can take at least 3-4 weeks. Confirm any English checklist exemption or delayed

should be included by the deadline if used. [s1] [s2] [s4]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minimum: TOEFL from January 21, 2026 onward overall 4.5 and each section 4.0; older test 90/each
20; IELTS Academic 6.5/each 6; CAEL 70/each 60; PTE 65/each 60; Cambridge C 1/C 2 180; DET 125/each 105.
Scores valid two years at submission, achieved in one sitting; TOEFL MyBest/Essentials not accepted, iBT Home
accepted. Official verification follows self-reporting. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No English test is required for an international applicant who completed a bachelor’s or higher taught and
examined in English in a country where English is primary. A completed UChicago degree meets this criterion
(inference from the US degree context). If still in progress, confirm when the completion-based exemption can
be recorded. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Recommended, optional, and considered useful by mathematics; not mandatory. The department explicitly
invites optional General and Mathematics Subject GRE results. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three, at least two from evaluators familiar with academic achievement. MSc references should assess
readiness for advanced study; PhD references original-research ability. Professional/institutional email, signed
institutional letterhead, and direct referee submission are required centrally; friends, relatives and romantic
partners are excluded. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Normal entrance-scholarship review reuses admission references/CV and expressly does not require new
letters. Some ongoing awards have their own reports: President’s PhD Scholarship needs a supervisor
evaluation; the mathematics departmental scholarship requires a chair nomination letter. These are not extra
universal admission letters. [s9] [s10]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
After form submission AND payment, enter/invite referees through the checklist/status portal. Do not expect
invitations merely from starting an application or recording an address before payment. Exact automatic-send
versus final invite-button behavior within the referee form is not documented publicly. [s2] [s3]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: central instructions locate reference invitations in Step 3, after submitted form and paid fee. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
goGRAD exposes an application checklist/status page; uploaded material normally receives a green check
within 10-15 minutes. The sources reviewed do not explicitly document a referee-specific confirmation email or
exact receipt label; verify each recommendation task before the deadline. [s3] [s23]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Referee details can be edited through the recommendation page before the document deadline; no changes
after it. A referee must submit separately for each application. Replacement of an already submitted letter was
not publicly established. Entrance-award review reuses admissions documents and will not update them solely
for scholarship review. [s3] [s10]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload. Prompt paraphrase: describe relevant research and academic activities throughout
undergraduate and any graduate study. No length, font, spacing or file-size limit is public; follow the current
upload field. [s1] [s3]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separately named SOP appears on the math checklist; the required research statement serves the
research-fit purpose. Additional SOP prompt or separate upload is not established. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement is listed for admission. Award invitations may require additional
information; do not invent a universal diversity essay. [s1] [s10]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required research statement, at most 1-2 pages as the department phrases it. Prompt paraphrase: explain
research interests so the application can be directed to matching faculty. Upload with supporting documents.
Font, margin, spacing and file-size limits are not published. [s1] [s3]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No separate detailed research proposal is listed for math admission beyond the research statement. Donor
entrance-award instructions permit a brief account of general interests/ideas if a research plan is not yet
available; candidates are not bound to the plan. Exact invitation-only limits are unverified. [s1] [s10]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No thesis, writing sample or research-summary upload is listed. Whether an optional paper may be uploaded or
linked is not established. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No standalone publication list is listed; relevant work may belong in the required CV. No instruction authorizes
uploading full papers or substitutes links for a requested file. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separately drafted course list is requested publicly. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Conflict]
SGES is departmental nomination, without a separate universal applicant essay. For donor entrance awards,
watch for a portal invitation requesting research interests/plan; exact form wording/length/format is not public.
For future need-based support, the international Knud George Pedersen fund requires an SFU transcript and
financial-need statement (no public length); Sidney Hogg requires transcripts,CV,one faculty letter and a need
statement. [s5] [s9] [s10]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
The goGRAD form asks research area/potential supervisors and incoming/requested funding information;
program-specific questions may appear after program selection. No other math essay is publicly documented.
[s3]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Standing math guarantee: CAD 25,000/year MSc; CAD 30,000/year PhD, gross across fall-summer, plus a
first-term SGES of CAD 2,500-10,000. Individual offer specifies composition. Tuition is not waived: central
2026-27 full-time rate CAD 2,192.57/term (three-term arithmetic CAD 6,577.71/year) plus other fees; this is not
2027-28 pricing. International and domestic math students pay the same tuition. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc six terms/two years; PhD twelve terms/four years, conditional on satisfactory performance. Summer is
included in the fall-summer funding year; installments can be uneven. Co-op/internship periods do not
consume guaranteed funding terms under the policy. [s6]
International eligibility [Conflict]
Regular mathematics guarantees and SGES include international students. Citizenship-specific awards are
separate. Provost International Fellowship requires a qualifying major home-country/equivalent scholarship;

central terms say CAD 1,500/term up to 2 years MSc/4 years PhD, conflicting with the math page’s CAD
5,000/year. Confirm the current PIF offer rather than adding either amount automatically. [s1] [s5] [s9]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Maintain CGPA≥3.5, satisfactory annual research progress, and satisfactory TA performance; apply for TA/GF
whenever eligible. Typical support combines two teaching terms and a fellowship/RA term. External
professional employment must be disclosed and may reduce support. Awards up toCAD 5,000/year are fully
additional; for larger awards at leastCAD 5,000 is additional, with further adjustment case by case. Tuition/fees
are paid from funding. [s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [Conflict]
Regular admission triggers initial support and SGES consideration. Later TA/GF applications are required when
eligible. Donor entrance awards may invite an additional portal form; ongoing awards use GA 3 and
department-specific deadlines. Do not treat the math page’s no-extra-application statement as covering all
later awards. [s1] [s6] [s9] [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Major donor entrance scholarships, research assistantships, TA appointments, graduate fellowships and
endowed awards can supplement/restructure support. The central donor-entrance page gives
award-dependent valuesCAD 7,000-50,000, whereas the math overview quotes older approximate
10,000-18,000. Examples relevant after enrollment include Peter Borwein Memorial and Mathematics Graduate
Scholarship; award-specific eligibility and current values control. PIF requires external major support. [s5] [s9]
[s10]
Application fee [Conflict]
Budget CAD 160 for UChicago/foreign transcripts under central goGRAD instructions; Canadian-transcript
rateCAD 112. The math page still quotesCAD 150/110, an official conflict. Visa/Mastercard credit cards,
including prepaid/gift credit cards, accepted; debit not accepted. Fee is nonrefundable. [s1] [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Mathematics explicitly states application-fee waivers are not granted. No mathematics exception or applicable
waiver request process was found. [s1]

Canada · Mathematics MSc / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 301-350. Additional research-fit program; outside Canada top ten including ties. Official QS
public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• All documents and three letters are dueJanuary11, 2027; pay/submit5-7days early to unlock reference
invitations.
• The department page contains multiple stale figures; preserve the central confirmations and verify portal
charges.
• MSc is the established bachelor’s entry route; direct PhD eligibility is not confirmed by mathematics.
• Funding is gross and includes work duties; there is no tuition waiver.
• No application-fee waiver is advertised.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
A completed UChicago bachelor’s permits MSc consideration, subject to minimum CGPA 3.0 or equivalent.
Mathematics specifies a completed master’s and CGPA 3.5 for PhD; exceptional transfer from an SFU MSc is
possible. Central regulations allow some bachelor’s-to-PhD admission at higher GPAs, but math’s narrower rule
controls unless the department confirms an exception. International applicants are eligible; F-1 is not Canadian
study authorization. [s1] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use goGRAD; prepare CV, a 1-2-page research statement, all postsecondary records and three referees.
Supervisor contact is optional. Submit the form and pay 5-7 days before the final deadline so the checklist and
reference invitations can be completed in time. No pre-application supervisor promise guarantees admission.
[s1] [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Optional before application: applicants need not secure a supervisor in advance and are matched by research
fit. Contact specific faculty about 2027 availability if desired; faculty cannot promise admission independently
of formal review. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
goGRAD sequence: form→payment→checklist/uploads/referee invitations. Submit/pay 5-7 days early. Status
page shows the program deadline and document checks; use recommendation-page Edit for referee
corrections before deadline. Decisions arrive via email linking to the portal; acceptance requires online reply
and deposit. [s2] [s3] [s8]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 dates explicitly confirmed centrally. Department heading mistakenly saysFall 2026 while giving
2026-27 application dates. Fee, TOEFL and tuition portions of math page lag central updates. Standing funding
policy applies to entrants fromFall 2024 onward but does not publish a 2027-28 tuition figure. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]

Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027: opens October 15, 2026; closes January 11, 2027. All materials must be complete then; no late
applications. No closing hour/time zone is stated. Central mathematics FAQ confirms Fall 2027, correcting the
department page’s inconsistent Fall 2026 label. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [Conflict]
Admission/regular funding/entrance nomination file: January 11, 2027. Math says all timely applicants receive
entrance-award consideration. Central donor-entrance process additionally describes invitations in March/April
and applicant information due April 30 (standing, year/time zone unspecified); confirm whether nominated
awards require this later step. [s1] [s2] [s10]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
All THREE reference submissions must be received by January 11, 2027, with the complete math application.
No separate grace period is advertised; time zone and closing hour are not public. [s1] [s2]
Test-score receipt [Conflict]
Complete-file deadline is January 11, 2027. Central English instructions allow self-reported scores at application
but note official verification can take at least 3-4 weeks. Confirm any English checklist exemption or delayed
verification with math; do not assume the self-report policy gives a blanket late-score extension. Optional GREs
should be included by the deadline if used. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
All admission uploads due January 11, 2027. Final official records are required after admission; send a
degree-in-progress transcript only after the degree is conferred and shown on it. Offer-specific conditions and
pre-enrollment requirements control final delivery. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s8]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Individual reply deadline appears in goGRAD; accept through the Admission Offer Reply form and pay the
nonrefundable enrollment deposit. No universal math deadline or deposit amount was established publicly.
Deposit is credited to first-term tuition. [s8]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minimum: TOEFL from January 21, 2026 onward overall 4.5 and each section 4.0; older test 90/each
20; IELTS Academic 6.5/each 6; CAEL 70/each 60; PTE 65/each 60; Cambridge C 1/C 2 180; DET 125/each 105.
Scores valid two years at submission, achieved in one sitting; TOEFL MyBest/Essentials not accepted, iBT Home
accepted. Official verification follows self-reporting. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No English test is required for an international applicant who completed a bachelor’s or higher taught and
examined in English in a country where English is primary. A completed UChicago degree meets this criterion
(inference from the US degree context). If still in progress, confirm when the completion-based exemption can
be recorded. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Recommended, optional, and considered useful by mathematics; not mandatory. The department explicitly
invites optional General and Mathematics Subject GRE results. [s1]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Disclose every postsecondary institution, including incomplete/current study. Upload an unofficial transcript for
each, in English/French or with translation. Degree certificate needed only if the final transcript omits
credential title/date. After offer, each official record must come directly through secure institutional delivery or
sealed mail; WES/ICES cannot replace it. [s3]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list is listed publicly; transcripts are required. Current program-specific portal
questions remain to be checked. [s1] [s3]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No syllabus or course-description document is publicly listed. No permission to add unsolicited descriptions was
established. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three, at least two from evaluators familiar with academic achievement. MSc references should assess
readiness for advanced study; PhD references original-research ability. Professional/institutional email, signed
institutional letterhead, and direct referee submission are required centrally; friends, relatives and romantic
partners are excluded. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Normal entrance-scholarship review reuses admission references/CV and expressly does not require new
letters. Some ongoing awards have their own reports: President’s PhD Scholarship needs a supervisor
evaluation; the mathematics departmental scholarship requires a chair nomination letter. These are not extra
universal admission letters. [s9] [s10]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
After form submission AND payment, enter/invite referees through the checklist/status portal. Do not expect
invitations merely from starting an application or recording an address before payment. Exact automatic-send
versus final invite-button behavior within the referee form is not documented publicly. [s2] [s3]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: central instructions locate reference invitations in Step 3, after submitted form and paid fee. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
goGRAD exposes an application checklist/status page; uploaded material normally receives a green check
within 10-15 minutes. The sources reviewed do not explicitly document a referee-specific confirmation email or
exact receipt label; verify each recommendation task before the deadline. [s3] [s23]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Referee details can be edited through the recommendation page before the document deadline; no changes
after it. A referee must submit separately for each application. Replacement of an already submitted letter was
not publicly established. Entrance-award review reuses admissions documents and will not update them solely
for scholarship review. [s3] [s10]

Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload. Prompt paraphrase: describe relevant research and academic activities throughout
undergraduate and any graduate study. No length, font, spacing or file-size limit is public; follow the current
upload field. [s1] [s3]

The goGRAD form asks research area/potential supervisors and incoming/requested funding information;

Standing math guarantee: CAD 25,000/year MSc; CAD 30,000/year PhD, gross across fall-summer, plus a

2026-27 full-time rate CAD 2,192.57/term (three-term arithmetic CAD 6,577.71/year) plus other fees; this is not
2027-28 pricing. International and domestic math students pay the same tuition. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc six terms/two years; PhD twelve terms/four years, conditional on satisfactory performance. Summer is
included in the fall-summer funding year; installments can be uneven. Co-op/internship periods do not
consume guaranteed funding terms under the policy. [s6]

Pay attention to
• All documents and three letters are dueJanuary11, 2027; pay/submit5-7days early to unlock reference

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
A completed UChicago bachelor’s permits MSc consideration, subject to minimum CGPA 3.0 or equivalent.
Mathematics specifies a completed master’s and CGPA 3.5 for PhD; exceptional transfer from an SFU MSc is
possible. Central regulations allow some bachelor’s-to-PhD admission at higher GPAs, but math’s narrower rule
controls unless the department confirms an exception. International applicants are eligible; F-1 is not Canadian
study authorization. [s1] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use goGRAD; prepare CV, a 1-2-page research statement, all postsecondary records and three referees.
Supervisor contact is optional. Submit the form and pay 5-7 days before the final deadline so the checklist and
reference invitations can be completed in time. No pre-application supervisor promise guarantees admission.
[s1] [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Optional before application: applicants need not secure a supervisor in advance and are matched by research
fit. Contact specific faculty about 2027 availability if desired; faculty cannot promise admission independently
of formal review. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
goGRAD sequence: form→payment→checklist/uploads/referee invitations. Submit/pay 5-7 days early. Status
page shows the program deadline and document checks; use recommendation-page Edit for referee
corrections before deadline. Decisions arrive via email linking to the portal; acceptance requires online reply
and deposit. [s2] [s3] [s8]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 dates explicitly confirmed centrally. Department heading mistakenly saysFall 2026 while giving
2026-27 application dates. Fee, TOEFL and tuition portions of math page lag central updates. Standing funding
policy applies to entrants fromFall 2024 onward but does not publish a 2027-28 tuition figure. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
[s6] [s7]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027: opens October 15, 2026; closes January 11, 2027. All materials must be complete then; no late
applications. No closing hour/time zone is stated. Central mathematics FAQ confirms Fall 2027, correcting the
department page’s inconsistent Fall 2026 label. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [Conflict]
Admission/regular funding/entrance nomination file: January 11, 2027. Math says all timely applicants receive
entrance-award consideration. Central donor-entrance process additionally describes invitations in March/April
and applicant information due April 30 (standing, year/time zone unspecified); confirm whether nominated
awards require this later step. [s1] [s2] [s10]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
All THREE reference submissions must be received by January 11, 2027, with the complete math application.
No separate grace period is advertised; time zone and closing hour are not public. [s1] [s2]
Test-score receipt [Conflict]
Complete-file deadline is January 11, 2027. Central English instructions allow self-reported scores at application
but note official verification can take at least 3-4 weeks. Confirm any English checklist exemption or delayed
verification with math; do not assume the self-report policy gives a blanket late-score extension. Optional GREs
should be included by the deadline if used. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
All admission uploads due January 11, 2027. Final official records are required after admission; send a
degree-in-progress transcript only after the degree is conferred and shown on it. Offer-specific conditions and
pre-enrollment requirements control final delivery. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s8]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Individual reply deadline appears in goGRAD; accept through the Admission Offer Reply form and pay the
nonrefundable enrollment deposit. No universal math deadline or deposit amount was established publicly.
Deposit is credited to first-term tuition. [s8]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minimum: TOEFL from January 21, 2026 onward overall 4.5 and each section 4.0; older test 90/each
20; IELTS Academic 6.5/each 6; CAEL 70/each 60; PTE 65/each 60; Cambridge C 1/C 2 180; DET 125/each 105.
Scores valid two years at submission, achieved in one sitting; TOEFL MyBest/Essentials not accepted, iBT Home
accepted. Official verification follows self-reporting. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No English test is required for an international applicant who completed a bachelor’s or higher taught and
examined in English in a country where English is primary. A completed UChicago degree meets this criterion
(inference from the US degree context). If still in progress, confirm when the completion-based exemption can
be recorded. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Recommended, optional, and considered useful by mathematics; not mandatory. The department explicitly
invites optional General and Mathematics Subject GRE results. [s1]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Disclose every postsecondary institution, including incomplete/current study. Upload an unofficial transcript for
each, in English/French or with translation. Degree certificate needed only if the final transcript omits
credential title/date. After offer, each official record must come directly through secure institutional delivery or
sealed mail; WES/ICES cannot replace it. [s3]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list is listed publicly; transcripts are required. Current program-specific portal
questions remain to be checked. [s1] [s3]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No syllabus or course-description document is publicly listed. No permission to add unsolicited descriptions was
established. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three, at least two from evaluators familiar with academic achievement. MSc references should assess
readiness for advanced study; PhD references original-research ability. Professional/institutional email, signed
institutional letterhead, and direct referee submission are required centrally; friends, relatives and romantic
partners are excluded. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Normal entrance-scholarship review reuses admission references/CV and expressly does not require new
letters. Some ongoing awards have their own reports: President’s PhD Scholarship needs a supervisor
evaluation; the mathematics departmental scholarship requires a chair nomination letter. These are not extra
universal admission letters. [s9] [s10]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
After form submission AND payment, enter/invite referees through the checklist/status portal. Do not expect
invitations merely from starting an application or recording an address before payment. Exact automatic-send
versus final invite-button behavior within the referee form is not documented publicly. [s2] [s3]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: central instructions locate reference invitations in Step 3, after submitted form and paid fee. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
goGRAD exposes an application checklist/status page; uploaded material normally receives a green check
within 10-15 minutes. The sources reviewed do not explicitly document a referee-specific confirmation email or
exact receipt label; verify each recommendation task before the deadline. [s3] [s23]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Referee details can be edited through the recommendation page before the document deadline; no changes
after it. A referee must submit separately for each application. Replacement of an already submitted letter was
not publicly established. Entrance-award review reuses admissions documents and will not update them solely
for scholarship review. [s3] [s10]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload. Prompt paraphrase: describe relevant research and academic activities throughout
undergraduate and any graduate study. No length, font, spacing or file-size limit is public; follow the current
upload field. [s1] [s3]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separately named SOP appears on the math checklist; the required research statement serves the
research-fit purpose. Additional SOP prompt or separate upload is not established. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement is listed for admission. Award invitations may require additional
information; do not invent a universal diversity essay. [s1] [s10]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required research statement, at most 1-2 pages as the department phrases it. Prompt paraphrase: explain
research interests so the application can be directed to matching faculty. Upload with supporting documents.
Font, margin, spacing and file-size limits are not published. [s1] [s3]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No separate detailed research proposal is listed for math admission beyond the research statement. Donor
entrance-award instructions permit a brief account of general interests/ideas if a research plan is not yet
available; candidates are not bound to the plan. Exact invitation-only limits are unverified. [s1] [s10]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No thesis, writing sample or research-summary upload is listed. Whether an optional paper may be uploaded or
linked is not established. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No standalone publication list is listed; relevant work may belong in the required CV. No instruction authorizes
uploading full papers or substitutes links for a requested file. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separately drafted course list is requested publicly. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Conflict]
SGES is departmental nomination, without a separate universal applicant essay. For donor entrance awards,
watch for a portal invitation requesting research interests/plan; exact form wording/length/format is not public.
For future need-based support, the international Knud George Pedersen fund requires an SFU transcript and
financial-need statement (no public length); Sidney Hogg requires transcripts,CV,one faculty letter and a need
statement. [s5] [s9] [s10]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
The goGRAD form asks research area/potential supervisors and incoming/requested funding information;
program-specific questions may appear after program selection. No other math essay is publicly documented.

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Standing math guarantee: CAD 25,000/year MSc; CAD 30,000/year PhD, gross across fall-summer, plus a
first-term SGES of CAD 2,500-10,000. Individual offer specifies composition. Tuition is not waived: central
2026-27 full-time rate CAD 2,192.57/term (three-term arithmetic CAD 6,577.71/year) plus other fees; this is not
2027-28 pricing. International and domestic math students pay the same tuition. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc six terms/two years; PhD twelve terms/four years, conditional on satisfactory performance. Summer is
included in the fall-summer funding year; installments can be uneven. Co-op/internship periods do not
consume guaranteed funding terms under the policy. [s6]
International eligibility [Conflict]
Regular mathematics guarantees and SGES include international students. Citizenship-specific awards are
separate. Provost International Fellowship requires a qualifying major home-country/equivalent scholarship;

central terms say CAD 1,500/term up to 2 years MSc/4 years PhD, conflicting with the math page’s CAD
5,000/year. Confirm the current PIF offer rather than adding either amount automatically. [s1] [s5] [s9]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Maintain CGPA≥3.5, satisfactory annual research progress, and satisfactory TA performance; apply for TA/GF
whenever eligible. Typical support combines two teaching terms and a fellowship/RA term. External
professional employment must be disclosed and may reduce support. Awards up toCAD 5,000/year are fully
additional; for larger awards at leastCAD 5,000 is additional, with further adjustment case by case. Tuition/fees
are paid from funding. [s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [Conflict]
Regular admission triggers initial support and SGES consideration. Later TA/GF applications are required when
eligible. Donor entrance awards may invite an additional portal form; ongoing awards use GA 3 and
department-specific deadlines. Do not treat the math page’s no-extra-application statement as covering all
later awards. [s1] [s6] [s9] [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Major donor entrance scholarships, research assistantships, TA appointments, graduate fellowships and
endowed awards can supplement/restructure support. The central donor-entrance page gives
award-dependent valuesCAD 7,000-50,000, whereas the math overview quotes older approximate
10,000-18,000. Examples relevant after enrollment include Peter Borwein Memorial and Mathematics Graduate
Scholarship; award-specific eligibility and current values control. PIF requires external major support. [s5] [s9]

Budget CAD 160 for UChicago/foreign transcripts under central goGRAD instructions; Canadian-transcript
rateCAD 112. The math page still quotesCAD 150/110, an official conflict. Visa/Mastercard credit cards,
